question: The study brief says each N level was run with and without TIS108 or PCIB, but GEO has only 4 groups: -N, +NO3-, -N + TIS108 and +NO3- + PCIB.
proposed_answer: Include all 12 samples. The N contrast is +NO3- vs -N (no inhibitor). TIS108 is usable only at -N and PCIB only at +NO3- (inhibitor contrasts); +NO3-+PCIB vs -N+TIS108 is not a valid N contrast.
evidence: GEO GSE162411 sample titles/characteristics; treatment protocol ’1 mM NO3-, 2 uM TIS108 and 1 mM NO3- plus 10 uM PCIB’.
